question: Can nonlinear composition among the five low-collateral attention pieces recover most v15 temporal behavior while restoring exact P/C top-one selectivity?
novelty: The preceding adaptive path tested only 153 extensions along one chosen chain and cannot exclude a selective subset off that chain. This is the first complete subset lattice over the v15 low-collateral attention pieces.
population: Exactly the same 16 A1, 16 A2, 16 P, and 16 C v15 rows in authority order. A1 selects; A2 is a no-reselection construction check but is not pristine identification because it contributed to earlier candidate localization.

candidate_rule.derivation: Exactly the candidates in the greedy result's stage-one atlas with pooled P/C median KL <=.02 and at most two top-one flips. No target-score threshold beyond membership in the already frozen 17-candidate pool is added here.

intervention: For each of all 32 subsets, jointly replace each selected head's complete 128-dimensional pre-c_proj response slice and/or attention 15's complete nine-head pre-c_proj response through the semantic query position. Execute the native suffix and report A1/A2 behavior, full final residual, and P/C full-vocabulary KL/top-one flips.
selection: An eligible subset has A1 behavioral signed projection >=.75, A1 direction fraction >=.875, zero P/C top-one flips, and pooled P/C median KL <=.02. Select fewest components, then largest A1 projection, then smallest five-bit mask. A2 never selects.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_lattice_clos: Authority hashes, candidate derivation, all 32 unique masks, row counts/order, and aligned shapes match; all-base self error <=1e-4; metrics are finite; exactly 35 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_target_sufficient_selective_subse: At least one subset is eligible on A1.
predictions.pred_c_selected_subset_confirms_without_: The selected subset reaches A2 behavioral signed projection >=.75 and direction fraction >=.875 without A2 selection.
predictions.pred_d_selected_subset_is_proper: The selected subset uses at most four of five pieces.
predictions.pred_e_every_selected_piece_is_necessary: Removing any selected piece makes the subset A1-ineligible or lowers A1 signed projection by >=.05.
predictions.pred_f_final_residual_tracks_selected_be: The selected subset has full-final-residual signed projection >=.50 on both A1 and A2.

terminal_policy.attention_construction_failure: A and B pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: If a selective subset confirms, freeze it for a genuinely fresh family and translate its OV/QK/value weight edges. If none exists, preserve the attention core as a nonselective partial path and begin task/control-conditioned within-MLP response splitting.
